disclaimer: Thresholds are OFFICIALLY PUBLISHED minimum-eligibility / shortlisting / published cutoff percentiles taken only from each institute's own documents. They are NOT guarantees of a call or admission and NOT closing percentiles; actual cutoffs are usually higher, and sectional, academic, work-experience and WAT/PI criteria also apply. "meets" = published General-category OVERALL threshold <= X; sectional minimums are listed per institute and are not checked.
basis: published General-category (or all-category) overall CAT percentile; non-IIMs: flagship programme row of the latest batch (2025-27 or later); stage given per institute (minimum_to_apply / shortlisting / final = last year closing as disclosed); IIMs: overall CAT percentile only; flagship programme; IIMs from programs/*.json (gender-specific IIMs use the Male/default row)
